magnesium_structure_retrieval_subtask_bm.name: Magnesium Structure Retrieval for Bulk Modulus
magnesium_structure_retrieval_subtask_bm.description: Retrieve structure of Magnesium and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

magnesium_potential_file_subtask_bm.name: Magnesium Potential File for Bulk Modulus
magnesium_potential_file_subtask_bm.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Magnesium for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

magnesium_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.name: magnesium Relaxation for Bulk Modulus
magnesium_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible magnesium structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of magnesium, based on the given simulation parameters. As the final output, return the absolute path of the relaxed structure.

magnesium_C11_subtask_bm.name: magnesium Elastic Tensor C11 Calculation
magnesium_C11_subtask_bm.description: Apply a small uniaxial finite strain ε<sub>xx</sub> to a relaxed magnesium structure while keeping all other strain zero. After applying each strain, perform structure relaxation for each strained structure. and extract σ<sub>xx</sub> from the relaxed structure. Use the linear stress–strain relationship σ<sub>xx</sub> = C<sub>11</sub> · ε<sub>xx</sub> to compute the elastic stiffness constant C<sub>11</sub> of magnesium in GPa units.
